package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/app/api/v1"
	"example.com/app/lib/v2"
	util "example.com/app/helpers/v3"
)

type Worker struct{}

func (w *Worker) String() string { return "w" }

var _ fmt.Stringer = (*Worker)(nil)

//go:linkname runtimeHook runtime.hook
func runtimeHook() { println("hook") }

func main() {
	v1.NewThing()
	lib.Open()
	util.Help()
}
